# Set a migration completion latch after the work has succeeded

Historical _nstmpCleanup checks a persistent completion preference, awaits each deletion, then sets the preference. A failed scan or removal therefore leaves the latch unset. MailGlue schedules it as best-effort idle work and catches/logs a task rejection; idle work may never run, so the migration cannot be a startup correctness prerequisite. Keep cleanup completion distinct from merely scheduling it. No failure injection or filesystem deletion was performed by this study.

Scope: Mbox migration lifecycle.
